package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TaskI18nRepoPG implements TaskI18nRepository.
type TaskI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Upsert inserts or updates task localization.
func (r TaskI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.TaskI18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_i18n (task_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (task_id, i18n_id)
DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description
`, entry.TaskID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Description)
	return err
}

// ListByTask lists all localizations for task.
func (r TaskI18nRepoPG) ListByTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT ti.task_id, ti.i18n_id, i.language, ti.title, ti.description
FROM task_i18n ti
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ti.i18n_id
WHERE ti.task_id = $1
ORDER BY i.language
`, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]domain.TaskI18n, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.TaskI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&entry.TaskID,
			&entry.I18nID,
			&entry.Language,
			&entry.Title,
			&entry.Description,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}

	if rows.Err() != nil {
		return nil, rows.Err()
	}

	return result, nil
}

var _ repository.TaskI18nRepository = (*TaskI18nRepoPG)(nil)
